note: Projected start times are re-derived on every tick from actual GO times, planned durations and fixed hard-starts, and the interval shrinks to protect a fixed part-two start, so a late cue pushes the curfew warning in real time; reorders FLIP the list rows, while timeline blocks are placed in cqi of their track and glide on transform. Space is GO, as on a show-caller's desk. Set --abk-cues-h to 100dvh in an app.
